observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: indoor competition hall with wooden floor, stage lighting and scoreboard visible in background
observation.dancers: several couples consisting of one man and one woman each
observation.formation_and_space: multiple couples scattered across a large wooden dance floor, moving around independently
observation.posture: upright torso with soft knees, body shifting weight dynamically
observation.footwork: fast stepping and weight transfers synchronised to the beat; exact foot placement details cannot be clearly seen due to camera motion
observation.arms_and_hands: arms held at shoulder or chest height with frequent hand-to-hand connections and turns under raised arms
observation.hips_and_torso: natural movement with rotation accompanying turns and weight changes
observation.partnering: partner dance with alternating open holds, closed holds, spins and underarm turns, with active lead and follow
observation.levels_jumps_turns: upright level throughout with spins and turns executed on the spot and while traveling
observation.costume_and_props: dancers wear shirts, ties, trousers and sneakers, while women wear sleeveless tops and trousers; numbers pinned to backs of some dancers
observation.cannot_infer: rapid footwork nuances and precise weight-shift mechanics are obscured by video compression and camera panning

signature_moments.what: lead spins the follower outward and pulls them back into a close embrace turn
underarm turn where follower spins under the raised arm of the leader while traveling
